description: Probe first. Native codegen calls box_int_for_any (fz_box_int_for_any) at seven sites in fn_ctx.rs (568, 643, 674, 788, 825, 894), at prim.rs:1702 (the int arm of negation, joined with the float arm as a ValueRef) and at receive.rs:290 (ReceiveValue::Int). Some of these are necessary: an any-typed join or a ValueRef argument needs a box. The rest box a value whose consumer could take it raw. Probe: run the JSON roundtrip and the 01164/01333/01336 fixtures with a per-site counter (telemetry event or alloc stats split by call site), so each site gets a box count. Prediction: negation of a value already narrowed to int, and receive of an int that is then used as an int, box needlessly. Acceptance: a census table, site by site, of necessary and needless boxes. Each needless site is removed under a scalar_box pin, and each necessary site is named with its reason.
title: A raw integer is boxed only where a value ref is the consumer
